$comment: The GJU German Year internship rules, read out of the documents in src/assets/gy-internships/. Defined once here: scripts/make-internship-tracker.mjs builds the workbook's Fit % and Check formulas from this file, and the workspace eligibility checker on the site scores against the same numbers. Change a rule here and both follow.

rules.salaryNote: Fiktionsbescheinigung / 3rd-semester enrolment both demand this much monthly income if the blocked account is not refilled.

countries: Deans' Council recommendation AND the President
score: The share of the skills the advert names that you actually have — 40 points for all of them, proportionally less otherwise. Matching is whole-word, so the skill 'R' matches "R" but not every advert containing the letter r. Paste the requirements as a comma-separated list and the share is exact; paste prose and it assumes at least three.
Full marks at {minWeeks} weeks or more, half at 15-19, nothing below 15. The {minWeeks}-week minimum is a hard GJU rule.
Germany 15, Austria/Switzerland/Luxembourg 12, anywhere else 5 - because anywhere else needs a Dean or the President to approve it.
Paid and at least {minMonthlySalary} EUR/month 15, paid but less 10, unknown 5, unpaid 0. {minMonthlySalary} EUR/month is what a visa extension asks you to prove.
English or bilingual 10. German-only is 10 if your German level is B2 or better, otherwise 5.
